title: Message envelope
description: Outer shape shared by every message of the contract, in both directions. The content is in 'data', defined by the schema of each message type.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version the sender follows (semantic version).

messageId.description: Unique id of this message, used to detect duplicate deliveries.

timestamp.description: When the sender created the message, in UTC.

data.description: Content of the message, depends on 'type'.

identifier.description: Safe to use inside an MQTT topic: no '/', '+' or '#'.

code.description: Open vocabulary in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (fault codes, reasons).
